prng: Python random.Random (MT19937); sample/randint on sorted candidate pools
selection: Within game: five distinct sessions without replacement. Randomly assign early/middle/late counts 2/2/1, with minority layer rotated in randomly permuted game order. Uniform integer-frame start within full layer. Final display order shuffled. No content-based exclusion.
technical_replacement_rule: Retry original selection first. If irrecoverably missing/corrupt, record failure and draw replacement within same game and time layer using continued seeded RNG; no replacements for quality/loading/menu/static/inapplicability.
